# Experiment record template

Status: template, not an executed experiment. Replace every field before reporting results.

## Identity and question

Experiment ID; authors/reviewers; date; code commit; hypothesis; falsifier;
scope; source references; preregistration location/time; changes after registration.

## Method

Dataset/version and license; train/dev/held-out split; inclusion/exclusion rules;
experimental conditions; baseline selection; exact resource budgets; primary and
secondary outcomes; sampling unit; repetitions; seeds; statistical method; stop rule.

## Runtime and data permissions

Runtime/SDK/model versions; prompts/configuration; source manifest; permitted
destinations; redactions; gateway/policy version; credential references (never values).

## Quantum extension, if applicable

Problem/Hamiltonian and units; encoding; circuit/observable artifact digests;
backend mode/provider/target; compiler and mapping; physical/logical qubits;
shots/evaluations; noise/calibration; mitigation; optimizer; queue latency;
access-readiness record; cost reservation; cancellation/unknown-outcome handling.

## Results and interpretation

Raw artifacts; failures and missing runs; complete costs; baseline results;
effect estimates and uncertainty; sensitivity analysis; hypothesis supported,
rejected or unresolved; alternative explanations; limitations; replication instructions.
No simulated or illustrative values may be labeled measured results.
